출애굽기-39-1.title: 출애굽기 39장 1절 역사문법적 주해
출애굽기-39-1.exegesis: 25. the silver of them that were numbered-- 603,550 men at half a shekel each would contribute 301,775 shekels; which at 2s. 4d. each, amounts to £35,207 sterling. It may seem difficult to imagine how the Israelites should be possessed of so much wealth in the desert; but it should be remembered that they were enriched first by the spoils of the Egyptians, and afterwards by those of the Amalekites. Besides, it is highly probable that during their sojourn they traded with the neighboring nations who bordered on the wilderness [Hewlett].

출애굽기-39-2.title: 출애굽기 39장 2절 역사문법적 주해
출애굽기-39-2.exegesis: CHAPTER 39 Ex 39:1-43 . Garments of the Priests. 1-2. cloths of service-- official robes. The ephod of the high priest, the robe of the ephod, the girdle of needlework, and the embroidered coat were all of fine linen; for on no material less delicate could such elaborate symbolical figures have been portrayed in embroidery, and all beautified with the same brilliant colors. (See on Ex 28:1-43 ).
